purpose: Diagnose whether the frozen Stage99 robust pair-QUBO is aligned with its own training BEDROC20 and outer-holdout BEDROC20 across all seven already available development targets. This is a mechanism diagnosis only, not replacement-objective tuning.

objective_under_diagnosis.objective_selection_aggregation: minimum rank for k=1; Stage99 two-support pair residual for k>=2
objective_under_diagnosis.primary_evaluation_aggregation: minimum empirical rank across selected receptors
objective_under_diagnosis.secondary_evaluation_aggregation: mean of the two best empirical ranks across selected receptors

splits.historical_outer_split: five-fold GroupKFold on the Stage99 target group field
splits.stage102a_outer_split: frozen outer_fold column in the received manifest
splits.enumeration: Every subset at k=1,2,3 is evaluated on outer-train and outer-holdout rows; outer values are never used to select a subset.

diagnostics.alignment_correlation: Spearman correlation between QUBO objective and BEDROC20 over all enumerated fixed-k subsets within each outer fold.
diagnostics.top_subset_transfer: Difference between outer BEDROC20 of the train-QUBO-optimal subset and the outer BEDROC20 ceiling across all enumerated subsets at the same k.
diagnostics.selection_metric_regret: For the train-QUBO-optimal subset, outer secondary-two-support BEDROC20 minus outer primary-minimum-rank BEDROC20. This is descriptive only and does not change the primary metric.
diagnostics.oracle_complementarity: Outer k=2 BEDROC20 ceiling minus outer k=1 BEDROC20 ceiling, reported as an upper bound on available two-receptor complementarity.
